name: perrinn_fw_sa_half_notopflap
notes: Design-variant test: 2-element wing. Frontwing2elements.step has two elements deleted from the 4-element baseline in Onshape (72 STEP corner points removed, 36 per side; mirror-symmetric; lowest point and 85.6 mm ride height unchanged). Same layered half-wing setup, Spalart-Allmaras. Expected: clearly less downforce and drag than baseline (Cl -1.1338, Cd 0.2121). (File name 'notopflap' is historical.)
